question: Which universal, protective, and chthonic identities are attributed to the deity here?
premises: The deity is addressed as god of all.
The deity is addressed as slayer of enemies of gods.
The deity is addressed as serpent of the depths.
inference: The deity is universal, protects gods, and has a chthonic serpent aspect.
plain_english: Obeisance to the god of all, obeisance to the slayer of the enemies of the gods, obeisance to the serpent of the depths.
